about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: The Lotus Craft Story
about.story_p1: Lotus Craft was born from a passion for the art of sewing and a commitment to providing exceptional garment and textile care in Helsinki. From expert alterations to professional rug washing and dry cleaning, we believe that every piece deserves the finest treatment.
about.story_p2: Located in the vibrant Kallio district, our workshop is where traditional craftsmanship meets modern techniques. Whether it's a beloved vintage dress that needs mending, a brand-new suit that needs the perfect fit, or a precious Persian rug that needs a professional wash — we treat every item with the same care and attention.
about.story_p3: Our team of skilled artisans brings years of experience and a genuine love for what they do. From the first consultation to the final stitch or the freshly cleaned rug returned to your door, we're dedicated to exceeding your expectations.
about.mission: To provide our customers with the best possible garment and textile care by combining traditional craftsmanship with modern expertise. We aim to make every alteration seamless, every cleaning impeccable, and every customer truly satisfied.
